name: Flashform design-repo
versionFieldNote: allowlistVersion is MACHINE-CHECKED (verify_all.py fails if it differs from tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json version). pageSpecVersion is checked against the schema const, and every PageSpec instance must carry that const. repositoryVersion is DOCUMENTATION-ONLY: hand-maintained, nothing checks it.

source.original: https://www.flshfrm.com/ (Flashform, a real live product site built by Emotion Agency)
source.clone: sibling project folder (React 18.3.1 + Vite 5.4 + Tailwind 3.4; gsap 3.10.4 + ScrollTrigger, split-type, ogl, matter-js 0.18.0)
source.snapshotNote: A snapshot, not a mirror. The clone source was being edited by other agents during this build; see CHANGELOG.md for the values re-checked at the end.
source.vcs: The clone folder is not a git repository, so the rule "never commit design-repo.zip alongside the live folder" is trivially satisfied. If it ever becomes one, gitignore design-repo.zip.

constraints: FORMS ARE STUBBED: the clone sets FORM_ENDPOINT = null; the original posts to a Formspree endpoint owned by the original site owner. PageSpecs use forms.submission "stub" or an owner-supplied https endpoint; the original endpoint is rejected (FORM_ENDPOINT_NOT_ORIGINAL).

REAL LIVE COMPANY: copy, videos (1.mp4, 2.mp4, screencast.mp4), the OG image (twitter.png), logo and favicon are proprietary. new-content PageSpecs reject the original copy, contacts and proprietary media (ORIGINAL_COPY_NOT_REUSED, ORIGINAL_CONTACTS_NOT_REUSED, ASSET_REF_POLICY).
COMMERCIAL FONTS: Aeonik, Recife Display (italic cut declared font-style normal) and Neue Haas Display are self-hosted from the original; a licence is required for any new deployment.
THIRD-PARTY MARKS: WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger and Discord icons are third-party trademarks (role icon.third-party-channel, pinned must-not-fabricate).
NO AI GENERATION of real logos, real people or the original proprietary content (assets/asset-roles.json licensing + pinnedPolicies).
SINGLE ROUTE: one route (/), one template; nav items are in-page anchors; all footer links are external.
MOTION QUIRKS KEPT ON PURPOSE: ease "linear.none" resolves to power1.out; ScrollTriggers created at staged times; page reloads on resize above 768px; hero u_mousePosition is effectively always (0,0).
DESIGN REVIEW PENDING: productionApproved=false; private reference build, do not publish or make public.
